rules: Never infer the content of a book from its cover alone.
Do not ingest copyrighted full text without lawful rights.
Prefer bibliographic metadata, scholarly criticism, public-domain passages, licensed/open sources, and human-authored summaries.
Preserve disagreement between critics instead of collapsing it.
Separate bibliography, interpretation, hypothesis, and MILK application.
No authorial flattening: derived competencies must not replace the source work.
